_comment: The English documents are authoritative. This file records exactly which
revision of each one the Japanese was built from, so drift is a check that
fails rather than a thing a reader has to notice.
sha256 is of the raw source file in the upstream repository, not of the
rendered document the service serves: the served copy has this deployment's
constants substituted into it and would differ between instances.
Run scripts/check_sync.py to verify. CI runs it on every push and daily.

manual.note: src/manual.md carries __CONSTANT__ placeholders that the server substitutes with the values it actually enforces. The translation keeps those placeholders verbatim, so no limit is ever written by hand in Japanese.

intro.note: Written in Japanese, not translated from anything. No upstream to drift from; it is a hands-on walkthrough of issuing a did:key on Windows. Excluded from the sync check by design.
